from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,difflib
root=Path('/home/ubuntu/Dev/skills'); out=root/'research/jstack/evaluations/authoring-a-skill'
base='3f38175b1b5c1eb557794d27d422ea4aa6215c23';cache='/home/ubuntu/.cache/jstack/upstream/upstream.git'
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=root).decode()
def upstream(pin,path):return git('--git-dir='+cache,'show',pin+':'+path)
def sha(s):return hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()
def diff(a,b,x,y):return ''.join(difflib.unified_diff(a.splitlines(True),b.splitlines(True),fromfile=x,tofile=y))
m=json.loads((root/'research/jstack/upstream.json').read_text());old=json.loads(git('show',base+':research/jstack/upstream.json'))
expected=json.loads(json.dumps(old));expected['skills'][0]['contextPaths'].append('pstack/skills/principle-encode-lessons-in-structure');assert m==expected
report={'base':base,'manifestCheck':'Only Encode Lessons in Structure mode context added; watch roots, pins, reviewed checkpoint, decisions and mappings preserved','mappedSkills':len(m['skills']),'comparisons':[],'packageChecks':[]}
for name in ['jstack-juan-mode','jstack-setup']:
 row=next(r for r in m['skills']if r['name']==name); pin=row['adaptedFrom'];local=row['localPath']+'/SKILL.md';source=row['upstreamPath']+'/SKILL.md';a=upstream(pin,source);b=(root/local).read_text()
 report['comparisons'].append({'local':local,'source':source,'pin':pin,'upstreamSHA256':sha(a),'localSHA256':sha(b),'completePinnedDiff':diff(a,b,source,local),'baseDiff':diff(git('show',base+':'+local),b,base,local),'assessment':row['differences']})
 assert upstream(pin,'pstack/LICENSE')==(root/row['localPath']/'LICENSE').read_text()
 files=git('ls-tree','-r','--name-only',base,'--',row['localPath']).splitlines();changed=[f for f in files if (root/f).read_text()!=git('show',base+':'+f)]
 assert changed==([local] if name=='jstack-juan-mode' else [local,row['localPath']+'/references/configuration.md'])
 report['packageChecks'].append({'package':name,'licenseMatchesPin':True,'existingFilesCompared':len(files),'changedExistingFiles':changed})
row=m['skills'][0];source=row['upstreamPath']+'/playbooks/authoring-a-skill.md';local=row['localPath']+'/playbooks/authoring-a-skill.md';a=upstream(row['adaptedFrom'],source);b=(root/local).read_text()
report['comparisons'].append({'local':local,'source':source,'pin':row['adaptedFrom'],'upstreamSHA256':sha(a),'localSHA256':sha(b),'completePinnedDiff':diff(a,b,source,local),'assessment':'research/jstack/adaptations/authoring-a-skill.md'})
report['upstreamPlaybooks']=git('--git-dir='+cache,'ls-tree','-r','--name-only',row['adaptedFrom'],'--',row['upstreamPath']+'/playbooks').splitlines();assert len(report['upstreamPlaybooks'])==23
report['localPlaybooks']=sorted(str(p.relative_to(root))for p in (root/row['localPath']/'playbooks').glob('*.md'));assert len(report['localPlaybooks'])==4
for path in expected['skills'][0]['contextPaths'][-1:]:
 listing=git('--git-dir='+cache,'ls-tree','-r','--name-only',row['adaptedFrom'],'--',path).splitlines();assert listing; report.setdefault('newContextSourceFiles',{})[path]=listing
f='skills/jstack/jstack-setup/references/configuration.md';report['configurationReferenceDiff']=diff(git('show',base+':'+f),(root/f).read_text(),base,f)
(out/'source-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(report['comparisons'][-1]['completePinnedDiff']);print(json.dumps(report['packageChecks']));print('41 mappings; 23 upstream/4 local playbooks; declared context paths exist.')
